description.value: Thompson Community Centre is a City of Richmond civic recreation facility serving the south Richmond neighbourhood near Granville Avenue. As part of Richmond's network of publicly operated community centres, it offers recreational programming to local residents and visitors. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's flat, cycling-friendly terrain may find it a convenient rest point, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities are unconfirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content fetched from the City of Richmond page for Thompson Community Centre consists almost entirely of site-wide navigation menus and truncated page headers; no substantive body content about the centre's specific amenities (bike parking, showers, washrooms, etc.) was captured. OSM tags confirm this is a civic community centre building operated by the City of Richmond at 5151 Granville Avenue, with a phone number and website that resolve to the correct City of Richmond domain. Because the website content provides no positive or negative evidence for any amenity, all amenity fields must be set to null per the rules.
concerns: Website content fetch returned only site-wide navigation menus; no body content specific to Thompson Community Centre was captured, leaving all amenity fields unverifiable.
OSM category is 'Attractions' but the facility is a municipal community centre — may be miscategorized in the source data.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Thompson Community Centre is a legitimate, operating civic facility in a cycling-friendly area of Richmond, but the fetched website content contained only site navigation with no substantive detail about amenities — none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed. A manual review of the facility or a direct call to +1-604-238-8422 is needed before a directory listing can be justified.
